description: Reserved parking spaces registered by Brussels Mobility (City of Brussels) is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Bruxelles/Data Management. Liste des places de parking recensées par Bruxelles Mobilité et situées sur le territoire de la Ville de Bruxelles Types: livraison, poids lourds, autocars, PMR, taxis, CD, police, motos, vélos, kiss and ride Plus d’info:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Parking, Parking, mobility, delivery, heavy goods vehicles, coaches. The portal shows 1,878 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
